In git history, the R4B TestScript source still carries the old malformed responseHeader example, while R5 and later in-core TestScript source replaced the example with prose pointing to the Testing FHIR assertions table.
additional_context: Current core no longer has source/testscript or an active testscript entry in source/fhir.ini. Commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed the in-core TestScript source folder and active metadata, and current core pages link TestScript to the external HL7/fhir-testing-ig. The external source and continuous build use the corrected prose comment.
reconciliation: No source file was changed in core. The audit records that the issue is outside the current core build and that the external current TestScript definition does not need the malformed-XML comment fix.
